name: GitHub issue: steps, expected and actual from a plain bug report
description: A customer describes a CSV export that fails. The issue names the problem and has steps to reproduce, expected and actual behaviour, without the customer's name or email.

input.subject: Export to CSV broken
input.body: Hi, since yesterday when I go to Reports, pick last month and click Export CSV, I get an error page saying 'Something went wrong'. I expected the file to download like before. Thanks, Jane
